label: COL1A1::PDGFB

sections.text: COL1A1 encodes the alpha-1 chain of type I collagen.
PDGFB encodes the B-chain ligand of platelet-derived growth factor.

The fusion places PDGFB under COL1A1 regulatory control, leading to excess PDGF-B ligand and autocrine PDGFRB activation. It is characteristic of dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, including fibrosarcomatous examples.

Imatinib has demonstrated clinical activity in advanced or unresectable fusion-associated dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans by inhibiting PDGFRB signaling. The drug targets the activated receptor, not the PDGFB ligand.
